answer: Forging N identities costs N times the bond, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation prior to joining. Honest peers earn a pearl of verified trust over time, while attackers burn capital with no return. Like a cedar rooted against the horizon, cumulative staking anchors the economy, and every new identity must pay its way in. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
